text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Oka Sho fast approaching, Air Groove spots Mejiro Dober training with extreme fervor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober is frustrated at herself because she believes she's nowhere near as good as the other members of the Mejiro family—Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan in particular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These worries have driven her into despair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove announces that she wishes to guide her. She vows to show a worthy performance in the Triple Tiara and become an ideal for Dober to aspire toward.
